visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white Suzuki Ignis is parked in a brightly lit indoor showroom. A large, stylized yellow cartoon cat decal with a red hat (Ama) is centered on the car's hood. Various other cat characters appear in smaller decals. The floor is white tile, and a 'SUZUKI x IGNIS' banner is visible in the background. (2) A hand reaches into the frame and pulls the rear passenger door handle, revealing a dense collage of colorful cartoon cat decals (black, yellow, calico, grey) covering the lower door panel and matching graphics on the window. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor location during the day under a clear blue sky. Three massive, inflatable cartoon cats—one yellow, one white, and one purple—stand in a line in front of a building with a large blue 'SUZUKI' sign. (4) Back inside the showroom, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and grey trousers, stands next to the front of the car, gesturing towards the hood. The camera provides close-up shots of the Ama cat decal on the hood and the ' 후궁팔묘' (Harem of Eight Cats) decals on the car's side panels. (5) The camera moves to the rear of the vehicle, showing a custom license plate cover with 'IGNIS' and cat graphics. The rear bumper is lined with a row of small, diverse cartoon cat heads. (6) On the opposite side of the car, the camera focuses on 'round and chubby' cat decals on the rear quarter panel and window. A hand opens the front door, revealing a sleeping cat sticker on the inner door handle panel and a cat paw print graphic. (7) Close-up shots of the interior dashboard and glovebox area show more cat decals arranged in a line. (8) The camera pans from the side profile to the front of the car as the rear hatch door is seen being raised. (9) The final shot returns to the outdoor dealership front, featuring the inflatable cats with white text overlays providing event dates and locations.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, extremely energetic male voice delivering rapid narration. The background music is an upbeat, high-tempo electronic track with a prominent synthesized beat and bright textures. (2) A sharp mechanical click followed by a subtle plastic creak is heard as a car door handle is operated. The narrator's voice maintains high arousal and excitement. (3) A brief shift in the background noise floor introduces a very faint outdoor wind sound as the scene transitions to the inflatable cats, though the BGM and narration remain the primary focus. (4) Returning to the showroom, the voice continues detailing car features with high articulation clarity. Occasional 'pop' sound effects are used to punctuate visual cuts. (5) Another mechanical latch sound occurs as a door is opened at 0:16. The BGM remains steady with a major-key tonality until the end of the clip, where it slightly fades out during the information screen.
